entities.summary: Carlos Ray "Chuck" Norris was an American martial artist, actor, screenwriter, and author. He held black belts in karate, taekwondo, Tang Soo Do, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, and judo. After serving in the United States Air Force, he won numerous martial arts championships and later founded his own discipline, Chun Kuk Do. Norris began working in the American film industry as a martial arts instructor for celebrities before making his screen debut with a minor role in The Wrecking Crew (1968). Friend and fellow martial artist Bruce Lee invited him to play one of the main villains in The Way of the Dragon (1972).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a martial artist and actor, Chuck Norris played a significant role in popularizing Eastern martial arts in the West, influencing generations of fighters and film enthusiasts. His iconic roles in films like The Delta Force (1986) and Missing in Action (1984) cemented his status as a cultural icon.
